grand-palace.name: The Grand Palace
grand-palace.price_text: ≈ THB 500 foreign visitor ticket (check on the day)
grand-palace.tip: Cover shoulders and knees or you will be turned away; go at opening to beat the heat and crowds.

wat-phra-kaew.name: Wat Phra Kaew
wat-phra-kaew.price_text: Included in the Grand Palace ticket
wat-phra-kaew.hours: Same hours as the Grand Palace · roughly 08:30–15:30
wat-phra-kaew.tip: The Emerald Buddha sits inside the Grand Palace grounds, so one ticket covers both — no shoes inside the chapel.
wat-phra-kaew.best: Early morning with the Grand Palace

wat-pho.name: Wat Pho
wat-pho.tip: See the giant Reclining Buddha, then try a short massage at the temple's own school.

wat-arun.name: Wat Arun
wat-arun.tip: Take the cross-river ferry from Wat Pho pier for a few baht; climb the central prang for river views.

wat-traimit.name: Wat Traimit
wat-traimit.price_text: ≈ THB 100–140 for the Golden Buddha hall (check on the day)
wat-traimit.tip: Home of the solid-gold Buddha; combine it with a walk through Chinatown next door.

wat-saket.name: Wat Saket
wat-saket.price_text: ≈ THB 50–100 to climb the Golden Mount (check on the day)
wat-saket.tip: A short staircase climb gives one of the best cheap panoramas of the Old Town.

chinatown.name: Bangkok Chinatown
chinatown.price_text: Free to walk · street food from around THB 50 a dish
chinatown.hours: Busiest evening into night · Yaowarat Road comes alive after dark
chinatown.tip: Come hungry after 18:00 and graze the Yaowarat stalls; go easy on the crowds and keep bags in front.

chatuchak.name: Chatuchak Weekend Market
chatuchak.price_text: Free entry · bring cash for stalls
chatuchak.hours: Sat–Sun roughly 09:00–18:00 · some sections open Friday
chatuchak.tip: It is huge — pick two or three sections, note your entrance number, and take the BTS to Mo Chit.

jim-thompson.name: Jim Thompson House
jim-thompson.price_text: ≈ THB 200 guided tour (check on the day)
jim-thompson.hours: Daily roughly 10:00–18:00 · last tour late afternoon
jim-thompson.tip: Entry is by guided tour only; the teak houses and garden make a cool break from the heat.

lumpini.name: Lumpini Park
lumpini.tip: Early morning and dusk bring joggers, tai chi and monitor lizards by the lake.

iconsiam.name: ICONSIAM
iconsiam.price_text: Free entry · food and shopping extra
iconsiam.tip: The indoor floating-market floor (SookSiam) is the easy way to try Thai street food in air-conditioning.
iconsiam.best: Late afternoon, then the riverfront at dusk

asiatique.name: Asiatique The Riverfront
asiatique.price_text: Free entry · free shuttle boat from Sathorn pier
asiatique.tip: Take the free boat from Sathorn pier; it is a night market and riverside walk rather than a sight.

khao-san.name: Khao San Road
khao-san.price_text: Free to walk · drinks from around THB 100
khao-san.hours: Always open · liveliest late evening into the night
khao-san.tip: It is a party street, not a sight — go for a drink and a look, and keep valuables close.

mahanakhon.name: King Power Mahanakhon
mahanakhon.price_text: ≈ THB 800–1,000 skywalk ticket (check on the day)
mahanakhon.tip: Book online for a lower price and go near sunset for both day and night views.

erawan-shrine.name: Erawan Shrine
erawan-shrine.tip: A small, busy shrine at a major junction — watch the dancers and keep it brief.

national-museum.name: Bangkok National Museum
national-museum.price_text: ≈ THB 200 foreign visitor ticket (check on the day)
national-museum.tip: Good for Thai art and history on a hot or rainy afternoon; check the day before you go.

chao-phraya-boat.name: Chao Phraya Express Boat
chao-phraya-boat.price_text: ≈ THB 15–40 per ride depending on the flag (check on the day)
chao-phraya-boat.tip: The cheapest river cruise in town — hop on and off at the temple piers instead of paying for a tourist boat.

thonburi-klong.name: Thonburi Klong Tour
thonburi-klong.price_text: ≈ THB 800–1,500 per boat, shared or private (check on the day)
thonburi-klong.tip: Longtail boats from the Tha Chang or Wat Arun piers show canal life; agree the price and route first.

giant-swing.name: The Giant Swing
giant-swing.price_text: Free to see from the street
giant-swing.hours: Always visible · Wat Suthat next door roughly 08:30–21:00
giant-swing.tip: A quick photo stop in front of Wat Suthat; combine it with a walk through the Old Town.

wat-benchamabophit.name: Wat Benchamabophit
wat-benchamabophit.tip: The white marble temple is quieter than the riverside sights and easy to reach by taxi.

safari-world.name: Safari World
safari-world.price_text: ≈ THB 1,000–1,600 depending on package (check on the day)
safari-world.tip: Far outside the centre — budget half a day for travel and check show times before booking.

talad-rot-fai.name: Talad Rot Fai Ratchada night market
talad-rot-fai.price_text: Free entry · food and drinks from around THB 50
talad-rot-fai.hours: Evening into late night · check which nights it runs
talad-rot-fai.tip: A relaxed night market with food stalls and bars, easy from the MRT at Thailand Cultural Centre.

baiyoke-viewpoint.name: Baiyoke Sky rooftop viewpoint
baiyoke-viewpoint.price_text: ≈ THB 300–500 observation deck (check on the day)
baiyoke-viewpoint.tip: A cheaper alternative to the Mahanakhon skywalk, with a full 360° view of the city.

thai-cooking-class.name: Half-day Thai cooking class
thai-cooking-class.price_text: ≈ THB 1,000–1,800 including market visit and lunch (check on the day)
thai-cooking-class.hours: Morning or afternoon sessions · book ahead
thai-cooking-class.tip: Most classes include a market walk and you cook and eat several dishes — a good rainy-day plan.

bang-krachao-walk.name: Bang Krachao green walk
bang-krachao-walk.price_text: Free · small ferry fare across the river
bang-krachao-walk.tip: The 'green lung' across the river is flat, shady and quiet — rent a bike or just walk the raised paths.

yaowarat-food-walk.name: Yaowarat street food walk
yaowarat-food-walk.price_text: ≈ THB 200–400 for a grazing dinner (check on the day)
yaowarat-food-walk.tip: Follow the longest queues and try a few small dishes rather than one big meal.

siam-walk.name: Siam Square and malls walk
siam-walk.tip: A cool, connected route between the big malls — good for a hot afternoon or a rainy hour.
